title: The Best Bikes of the 2026 MADE Show: Aero Steel, 32-Inch Wheels, and a 13-Pound Steel Climber
content:
Forget factory constraints. Independent builders are combining sheet-metal steel, repurposed shifter tech, and cutting-edge geometry to redefine what a custom bike can do. We tracked down the five best examples at this year's show.

Read the full article at The Best Bikes of the 2026 MADE Show: Aero Steel, 32-Inch Wheels, and a 13-Pound Steel Climber on Velo.
author: Josh Ross
